text: I've heard men say, well, if women make as much money as men, they won't need us anymore. Sir. What ugly woman told you that? We will always need men. Trash day is Tuesday. So, this is what modern female stand-up has come to? This is considered funny now? Look, I'm not saying all female comedy is bad. There are some genuinely great female comedians who can make sharp, clever jokes, including jokes about men. But since when did simply insulting men become a punchline? When did men are useless except for trash day turn into comedy instead of just lazy writing? It is honestly wild that some comedians can build an entire career on lines like this. And even crazier that there is an audience cheering for it. Anyway, let's watch another one. Really useless. Really useless to have a husband. If you're trying to get pregnant, just do it and get a nanny. That's all I... Just do that. No, I mean, I have like a really good husband too and he's still useless. Well, here's another masterpiece of modern female stand-up. So, what is the recipe? Take a cheap shot at men, exaggerate it beyond reality, deliver it with zero artistry and hope that women in the audience will laugh? And somehow, it actually works. It's honestly baffling that routines like this count as comedy today. No structure, no wit, no clever twist, just men are bad. But you know what is actually funny here? That this doesn't say anything about men and says everything about the quality of the material and the people applauding it. As Rick once said, your boos mean nothing, I've seen what makes you cheer.
